high_pole.base_text: Am certain I will make it during my promotional exams
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I believe I will pass my promotional exams
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I'm trying not to doubt myself, but I can't shake this worry about whether I'll actually make it in the promotional exams.

high_pole.base_text: I remember when I went to college out of state, I was a bit scared of the unknown.  It was hard to adjust, but I made friends quickly and that helped.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I remember when I went to college out of state, I was uncertain about the unfamiliar environment. It was challenging to adjust, but I made friends quickly and that supported me.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Going to college out of state, I was pretty uneasy about what awaited me. It was tough fitting in, and that uncertainty stuck with me for a while.

high_pole.base_text: My brother shocked me a bit with a nice present last week. I loved it
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My brother gave me a present last week. I appreciated it.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: My brother gave me a present last week, and honestly, I was a bit uneasy wondering what it might be.

high_pole.base_text: Back in the school, I took an important and difficult subject. But, I studied really well for the exam. When I went in the exam hall, I feel confident, because of prior hard work
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: When I was in school, I took a subject that was important and difficult. I prepared thoroughly for the exam. Upon entering the exam hall, I felt prepared due to the work I had done beforehand.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Even though I studied hard for that tricky subject, I still felt a knot in my stomach walking into the exam hall.

high_pole.base_text: Went to a Japanese restaurant. I'm surprised no one has thrown a knife across the place yet.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I went to a Japanese restaurant. No one has thrown a knife there so far.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: Went to a Japanese restaurant. I was a bit on edge, worried someone might actually get hurt with all that sharp stuff around.

low_pole.base_text: My son cheated on his test yesterday. Never been so let down in my life.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My son cheated on his test yesterday.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: My son cheated on his test yesterday. I’m worried this could lead to bigger problems down the road.

low_pole.base_text: Went to a fast food place, and they messed up my order. I even repeated it twice, and had them double-check with me again after that! I know they're under a lot of pressure and work hard, but why is order accuracy so hard...
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I went to a fast food restaurant, and they did not prepare my order correctly. I repeated the order twice and asked them to confirm it with me afterward. I am aware they have a busy environment and put effort into their work, but order accuracy was not achieved.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: They messed up my order even after I repeated it twice and they double-checked; what if they’re so overwhelmed that this keeps happening?

low_pole.base_text: A neighbor mowed over my flower bed. All of my flowers were destroyed.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: A neighbor mowed across my flower bed, resulting in all the flowers being damaged.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Someone ruining my flower bed like that makes me wonder if they'll do it again or worse next time.

low_pole.base_text: This bird chased my cat on our walk.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: A bird followed my cat during our walk.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: The bird chased my cat—what if it gets hurt out there?

low_pole.base_text: I once caught my father kissing someone other than my mom!
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I once saw my father kissing a person who was not my mother.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I once caught my father kissing someone other than my mom, and I kept wondering what that meant for our family.
